custom_fields.label: B Qty %
custom_fields.description: Entered as a percentage of A Qty (not an absolute quantity) - e.g. 10 means AB Qty = A Qty x 1.10.

custom_fields.label: AB Qty
custom_fields.description: = A Qty x (1 + B Qty% / 100). Recalculated on save.

custom_fields.label: Batch
custom_fields.description: Auto-created on Sales Order submit: one Batch per (Item, Color).

custom_fields.label: Greige Batch
custom_fields.description: Auto-created on Sales Order submit: one shared Batch per Item (same across every row/color for that Item), used for Weaving Receipt, Dyeing Contract fabric issue, and Dyeing Receipt repack.

custom_fields.label: Total Packs
custom_fields.description: 2026-09-28 (feature v3) - = A Qty x Pcs per Pack, per your formula. Recalculated on save. Used by the Trims & Accessories Material Request for trims whose Consumption Unit is Per Pack.

custom_fields.label: Total Ctn
custom_fields.description: = AB Qty / (Pcs per Pack x Pack Per Ctn). Recalculated on save.

custom_fields.label: Towel Costing Sheet
custom_fields.description: Set from the source Towel Costing Sheet when the Sales Order is created via Get Items From. Used by mjfsd/emadi to resolve raw materials, dyeing contracts, and weaving receipts back to the originating costing sheet. Was present on production as a manually-added Custom Field but had never been exported into this app's fixtures - added 2026-09-25.

custom_fields.label: GSM
custom_fields.description: 2026-09-28 (feature v3) - fetched from the Towel Costing Sheet's Finish Item table (the row whose Article matches this row's Item). Recalculated on save and live when Item or Towel Costing Sheet changes on the row.
